questions.title: 1.2.3 Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded) mini-assessment

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: The presenter says “Choose this option” while pointing silently. What is missing?

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: Which alternatives does 1.2.3 permit?
choices: Audio description or an alternative for time-based media

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: Does a text alternative alone satisfy 1.2.5?

answer_key.q_2: Audio description or an alternative for time-based media

explanations.q_1: The listener needs the option identified.
explanations.q_2: Either approach can satisfy this Level A criterion subject to the exception.
explanations.q_3: The Level AA requirement separately calls for audio description.
